comment: Russian filler / retake vocabulary for cut-mistakes. Matching uses normalized keys: lowercase, ё→е, letters and digits only (so «э-э» → «ээ»). Edit freely; the detector and tests read this file.

hesitations.comment: Pure hesitation sounds. Safe to cut by default (high confidence).

fillers.comment: Verbal fillers that are sometimes meaningful. Proposed for review, never auto-cut: «вот» and «значит» are often real words.

retakeMarkers.comment: Phrases a speaker says before restarting a take. A marker makes the preceding unfinished fragment a likely abandoned take.

signature.comment: Russian is inflected: compare retake signatures on a word prefix so «время» and «времени» match.
